points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: CMake build is documented; committed report builds in an isolated immutable worktree, but a clean solver build was not possible because the delivered external symlink is dangling.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp/config parsing provide solve/info and input checks; not rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separated config, mesh, numerics, driver, and main modules.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal wrapper/executable evidence; trust policy prohibits external similarity search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: CGNS and case parsing are generic rather than filename-only branches.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS partitioning, ghosts, neighbor exchange and reductions are present; no submitted rank-count comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallbacks and status output exist, but Re200 inner solve fails.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: No committed tests; structural validator is external evidence only.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated submission excludes build/results/session artifacts and source is organized.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
